entities.summary: Daniel Estrada Pérez, also known as Qosqoruna, was a Peruvian lawyer and politician known for his contributions to the urban development and heritage preservation of Cusco. He served as the Provincial Mayor of Cusco Province, which contains the city of Cusco, from 1984 to 1986 and again from 1990 until 1995. Estrada was then elected to the Congress of the Republic of Peru, where he served from 1995 to 2003.
